clips.title: The story
paras: The Test of Righteousness culminates at Jordan Stilwell's forge outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh. After gathering perilous components from across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, a paladin waits while the smith crafts a mighty warhammer. It marks the transition of an apprentice into a recognized champion of the Light.

Master smith Jordan Stilwell plies his craft outside the gates of Ironforge. While he admits to a touch of envy toward wandering paladins, he takes profound pride in supporting the cause through his hammer and anvil. Once presented with rare materials gathered from shadowy crypts, sunken ruins, and dangerous mines, Stilwell fulfills his promise to forge a weapon worthy of a true defender.

The finished warhammer is christened Verigan's Fist in honor of Bosch Verigan, an honored dwarven paladin and dear personal friend of Jordan Stilwell. By passing this sacred weapon into a young champion's hands on behalf of himself and his wife, Stilwell ensures that the memory and valor of his fallen friend endure against the darkness threatening Azeroth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.
When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.
I'll be somewhat honest, friend, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here it is, friend. A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. I've named it after a great dwarven paladin who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan.
Please take it on behalf of myself and my wife. We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.
